bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
WT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.worktrees/search-colors-5a93de6"
test "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = 5a93de671ee158205759bb6e264cd3cd48466743
LOG="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$LOG"' EXIT
if docker build --progress=plain -f "$WT/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:search-color-5a93de6 "$WT" >"$LOG" 2>&1; then exit 0; fi
python3 - "$LOG" <<'PY'
import pathlib,re,sys
s=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(errors="replace")
patterns=[
(111,r'Cannot find matching keyid|signature.*key|keyid.*signature'),
(112,r'corepack: not found|corepack: command not found|/bin/sh: corepack'),
(113,r'unable to get local issuer certificate|CERT_HAS_EXPIRED|SELF_SIGNED_CERT|TLS'),
(114,r'connect ETIMEDOUT|network timeout|fetch failed|ECONNRESET|ENOTFOUND'),
(115,r'403 Forbidden|429 Too Many Requests|401 Unauthorized'),
(116,r'no space left on device|disk quota exceeded'),
(117,r'EACCES|permission denied'),
(118,r'out of memory|killed|exit code: 137'),
(119,r'Internal Error: Error when performing the request'),
(120,r'ERR_PNPM_|ERR_SOCKET|ECONNREFUSED'),
(121,r'Error:.*package manager|pnpm.*version'),
]
for code,pat in patterns:
 if re.search(pat,s,re.I):sys.exit(code)
sys.exit(122)
PY
